description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SAP Security, GRC Access Control and Identity Management Specialist**
**Professional Job Description For Modern SAP Landscapes**
Scope: SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, BW and integrated SAP platforms
  
  
**Role Type**
: SAP Security, GRC, IDM and Access Governance
  
  
**Seniority :**
Senior Analyst / Consultant / Specialist / Lead, depending on experience
  
  
**Primary Focus**
: User access management, role lifecycle, GRC operations, IDM provisioning, risk ruleset management, audits and access reviews
  
  
**Landscape :**
SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC AC/PC, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and related integrations
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for an experienced SAP Security, GRC and Identity Access Management professional to manage end-to-end SAP user access, role design, identity lifecycle, access governance, emergency access, risk analysis, audits and security operations across a complex SAP landscape. The role will support SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC Access Control, SAP GRC Process Control, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, SAP Ariba, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and other integrated SAP applications.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for SAP user management, SAP role design and maintenance, GRC operations, access risk analysis, SAP Firefighter governance, user access review implementation, quarterly access reviews, risk ruleset management, SoD remediation support, country rollouts, SAP native security assessments and audit support. The role requires strong process discipline, documentation quality and audit-ready execution across run, change and project activities.
  
  
**Key Accountability Areas**
Area - Expected Ownership
  
  

* SAP User Access Management : Create, modify, maintain and revoke SAP user access using approved access request, provisioning and governance processes.
* SAP Role Management : Own role requirement gathering, role design, build, testing, transport, go-live and ongoing maintenance.
* SAP GRC Access Control : Administer GRC Access Control processes across ARA, EAM, ARM and access governance workflows.
* SAP GRC Process Control : Support quarterly CCM updates, control monitoring, exception validation and control evidence management.
* SAP IDM : Manage identity lifecycle workflows, provisioning, deprovisioning, reconciliation and connector issue resolution.
* Access Reviews and Audits : Implement and operate user access reviews, firefighter reviews, audit evidence packs and remediation tracking.
* Risk Ruleset Management : Design, maintain, test and govern SoD and critical access rulesets for SAP and integrated applications.
* SAP Native Security : Assess SAP authorization, user, privileged access, RFC, technical user and security configuration risks.

**Detailed Responsibilities**

* SAP User Access Management

+ Manage SAP user ID creation, modification, lock, unlock, validity updates, role assignment, termination and periodic user maintenance across SAP systems.
+ Support access provisioning and deprovisioning through SAP IDM and SAP GRC Access Control workflows.
+ Handle access requests, emergency requests, weekend releases and production access support activities.
+ Ensure access is provisioned based on approved requests, business need, least privilege and segregation of duties requirements.
+ Maintain user master data, license-relevant user classifications, technical users, communication users and validity controls.

* SAP Role Management

+ Design, build, test and maintain SAP security roles for SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW, Fiori, BTP integrations and related SAP platforms.
+ Perform role requirement gathering with business process owners, functional teams, control owners and country rollout teams.
+ Translate business requirements into authorization concepts, role matrices, derived roles, composite roles and Fiori catalogs, groups, spaces or pages.
+ Own the role lifecycle from requirement gathering, design, build and unit testing through UAT, defect remediation, transport movement, go-live and hypercare.
+ Support role redesign, role cleanup, SoD reduction, access optimization and country-specific role rollout activities.

* SAP GRC Access Control Management

+ Administer SAP GRC Access Control modules including Access Risk Analysis, Emergency Access Management, Access Request Management and Business Role Management where applicable.
+ Configure and support GRC workflows, approval paths, request types, provisioning settings, connectors and access request exceptions.
+ Perform access risk analysis for users, roles, access requests and role changes.
+ Monitor and resolve GRC provisioning failures, workflow issues, connector errors and control exceptions.
+ Support integrated access governance across SAP S/4HANA, BW, Ariba, SuccessFactors, BTP and other connected applications.

* SAP GRC ARA and Risk Ruleset Management

+ Manage SAP GRC ARA risk analysis for users, roles, profiles, critical transactions and sensitive authorization combinations.
+ Design, update and maintain SAP risk rulesets including risks, functions, actions, permissions and mitigating controls.
+ Perform ruleset impact assessment, regression testing and approval tracking before production deployment.
+ Coordinate SoD risk remediation, mitigation control assignment and risk owner sign-off.
+ Maintain ruleset documentation, change history, test evidence and version control.

* SAP Firefighter and Emergency Access Management

+ Manage SAP Firefighter ID setup, owner assignment, controller assignment, reason codes and emergency access configuration.
+ Support emergency access request, approval, usage monitoring, log review and closure processes.
+ Perform SAP GRC Firefighter log reviews and coordinate timely controller review and sign-off.
+ Investigate unauthorized, excessive or inappropriate firefighter usage and track remediation actions.
+ Maintain audit-ready evidence for firefighter assignment, usage, review, exceptions and approvals.

* SAP User Access Review Implementation and Quarterly Reviews

+ Implement SAP user access review campaigns using SAP GRC or approved access certification tools.
+ Prepare user, role, critical access, SoD, privileged access and firefighter review datasets.
+ Coordinate quarterly access reviews with managers, role owners, process owners and control owners.
+ Track review completion, access retention, revocation, exceptions, remediation actions and management approvals.
+ Maintain complete evidence for internal audit, external audit and compliance reporting.

* SAP GRC Process Control and Quarterly CCM Updates

+ Support SAP GRC Process Control operations, control mapping, monitoring rules and issue tracking.
+ Perform quarterly Continuous Control Monitoring updates based on process, configuration, risk and control changes.
+ Maintain CCM business rules, monitoring schedules, exception logic and control owner assignments.
+ Coordinate with process owners to validate CCM exceptions, control failures and remediation actions.
+ Prepare control evidence, deficiency documentation and management reporting.

* SAP IDM and Identity Lifecycle Management

+ Manage identity lifecycle processes in SAP IDM including joiner, mover, leaver, role assignment, provisioning and deprovisioning workflows.
+ Support integrations between SAP IDM, HR source systems, SAP GRC, SAP systems and downstream applications.
+ Maintain IDM workflows, connectors, provisioning rules, approval logic and reconciliation processes.
+ Troubleshoot provisioning failures, access synchronization issues and identity data inconsistencies.
+ Support future-state IAM planning involving SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP IAG or enterprise identity platforms where applicable.

* Country Rollouts and Release Support

+ Support SAP security activities for new country rollouts, company code rollouts, business process deployments and regional templates.
+ Gather local access requirements and align them with global role design, control standards and SoD requirements.
+ Prepare access matrices, role mapping, test scripts, cutover plans and go-live readiness evidence.
+ Support unit testing, UAT, defect resolution, transport movement, weekend release and hypercare activities.
+ Ensure country-specific access is secure, approved, tested and audit-ready before production use.

* SAP Native Security Assessment and Audit Support

+ Perform SAP native security assessments across S/4HANA, ECC, BW, GRC, Solution Manager, BTP-integrated applications and other SAP platforms.
+ Review SAP authorization objects, critical transactions, privileged users, RFC users, communication users, generic IDs and sensitive access.
+ Identify excessive access, weak role design, unused roles, shared IDs, control gaps and configuration weaknesses.
+ Support SAP internal audit, external audit, SOX, ITGC and compliance reviews.
+ Prepare audit evidence packs, management responses, remediation plans and closure validation evidence.

**SAP Application Scope**

* SAP S/4HANA on RISE / Private Cloud Edition
* SAP GRC Access Control
* SAP GRC Process Control
* SAP IDM
* SAP BTP
* SAP Ariba
* SAP SuccessFactors
* SAP BW / BW4HANA
* SAP Fiori Launchpad
* SAP Solution Manager
* SAP Cloud Identity Services / IAS / IPS, where applicable
* Integrated non-SAP systems connected to SAP access governance

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP Security, SAP GRC Access Control and SAP user administration.
* Experience in SAP role design, role build, UAT support, transport movement and production deployment.
* Working knowledge of SAP GRC ARA, EAM, ARM and risk ruleset management.
* Experience with SAP Firefighter ID management, log review and emergency access governance.
* Experience implementing and operating SAP user access reviews and quarterly access certification processes.
* Experience with SAP IDM provisioning, workflows, connectors and identity lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA security, Fiori security, authorization objects and business role concepts.
* Understanding of SAP GRC Process Control and Continuous Control Monitoring.
* Experience supporting SAP internal audits, external audits, SOX, ITGC and compliance reviews.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, evidence management and issue resolution skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA on RISE or hybrid SAP cloud landscapes.
* Knowledge of SAP BTP security, role collections, identity provider integration and cloud authorization concepts.
* Experience with SAP Ariba and SAP SuccessFactors access governance.
* Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services, IAS, IPS, SAP IAG or Microsoft Entra ID integration.
* Awareness of cross-application SoD risks across SAP and cloud applications.
* Experience in global SAP template rollouts and country-specific security deployments.
* Knowledge of SOX, ITGC, NIST, ISO 27001 or internal control frameworks.

title: Supplier Due Diligence Analyst (ESG) & Cyber Security
description:
Job Title
  
  
Supplier Due Diligence Analyst (ESG) & Cyber Security
  
  
**Job Description**
**Supplier Due Diligence Analyst (ESG) & Cyber Security | Pune | Full-time**
Vanderlande is seeking a proactive and analytical Supplier Risk & Due Diligence Analyst (ESG & Cyber Security) to support the global Supplier Sustainability & Risk function within Procurement.
  
  
As part of Vanderlande’s global procurement organization, you will play a key role in assessing supplier risks and ensuring our supply base operates in line with sustainability, compliance, and cyber security expectations. You will contribute to a resilient, responsible, and future-proof supplier ecosystem by supporting supplier due diligence, ESG assessments, third-party cyber security reviews, and ongoing supplier risk monitoring.
  
  
Our global procurement organization enables projects and business functions by maximizing value and minimizing risks through the procurement of goods and services in a smart, cost-effective, sustainable, and secure way.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Supplier Risk & Due Diligence Analyst, you will support supplier qualification, onboarding, monitoring, reassessment, and remediation activities across multiple risk dimensions. You will work closely with Procurement, Sustainability, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, business stakeholders, and suppliers to evaluate and manage supplier-related risks throughout the supplier lifecycle and support risk management activities embedded within Vanderlande's Source-to-Pay (S2P) processes.
  
  
A key part of the role will be supporting the adoption and operational use of supplier risk and cyber security monitoring tools, including BitSight or other approved risk intelligence platforms, to assess third-party cyber exposure, identify risk indicators, and support timely follow-up actions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support execution of supplier due diligence activities as part of supplier onboarding, qualification, periodic reassessment, and ongoing monitoring processes.
* Conduct supplier risk assessments across ESG, cyber security, information security, financial stability, compliance, geopolitical, operational, and business continuity risk dimensions.
* Review supplier information, responses, supporting documentation, certifications, policies, and evidence to validate due diligence outcomes and identify potential risk indicators and information gaps.
* Review supplier cyber security documentation, including security questionnaires, ISO 27001 certifications, NIS2, SOC reports, data privacy indicators, business continuity documentation, and third-party cyber risk ratings.
* Support the implementation and operational use of BitSight or similar approved cyber risk intelligence platforms, including supplier monitoring, cyber risk score analysis, follow-up of identified risk indicators, and reporting to relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor supplier risk intelligence sources and identify emerging risks requiring escalation, mitigation, reassessment, or stakeholder review.
* Analyze supplier risk data and prepare clear insights, dashboards, reports, and management updates for procurement and governance forums.
* Review supplier documentation and due diligence evidence against established responsible sourcing, sustainability, compliance, and governance requirements, highlighting potential concerns and coordinating follow-up with relevant stakeholders
* Coordinate remediation activities with suppliers and internal stakeholders, ensuring actions are tracked, documented, and followed up within agreed timelines.
* Maintain accurate supplier risk records, assessment outcomes, documentation, dashboards, and reporting within approved systems and tools.
* Collaborate with Procurement, Sustainability, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, IT, and business teams to ensure an integrated supplier risk management approach.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of supplier due diligence, ESG, risk, and cyber security assessment processes, templates, tools, and governance routines.
* Ensure all activities are executed in compliance with company policies, governance standards, confidentiality requirements, and regulatory expectations.

**What You Bring**
To succeed in this role, you bring a strong combination of analytical thinking, operational discipline, stakeholder collaboration, and risk awareness. You are comfortable working in a dynamic global environment and can translate supplier risk data into clear, actionable insights.
  
  
You should bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, Sustainability, Risk Management, Information Security, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience in supplier risk management, due diligence, procurement, sustainability, compliance, cyber security, audit, or a related field.
* Good understanding of supplier lifecycle management, third-party risk management, supplier onboarding, and supplier reassessment processes.
* Knowledge of ESG frameworks, responsible sourcing practices, sustainability regulations, and supply chain due diligence expectations.
* Understanding of cyber security and information security concepts, including third-party cyber risk, information security controls, ISO 27001, NIS2, SOC reports, data privacy, GDPR, business continuity, and disaster recovery.
* Experience with supplier risk, due diligence, compliance, ESG, or cyber risk monitoring platforms. Experience with BitSight or similar cyber risk intelligence platforms is preferred.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and other data analysis or reporting tools.
* Ability to assess supplier documentation, identify gaps, and translate findings into clear risk summaries and follow-up actions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across procurement, suppliers, technical teams, and global stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

description:

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
Mastercard Transaction Services (MTS) is the regulated legal entity within Mastercard that enables transaction services and related payment capabilities in line with applicable regulatory requirements. MTS retains regulatory accountability for its services, while Mastercard corporate functions and affiliated service providers deliver operational, technology and information security services under an oversight and assurance model. This structure requires strong governance, effective risk management, clear control ownership and ongoing evidence of regulatory compliance.
  
  
Role
  
  
This role supports the first line Technology Risk Management function for MTS, helping to operationalize the technology risk framework, coordinate regulatory and supervisory reporting, and provide assurance over technology, cyber and third-party risk obligations.
  
  
The role works closely with MTS leadership, Mastercard corporate functions, Information Security, Technology, Compliance, Operational Resilience, Legal Entity Management and Internal Audit.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a proactive, outcomes-focused technology risk professional who can operate effectively in a regulated environment, build trusted relationships across functions, and translate complex technology and cyber risk matters into clear, actionable insights for management and governance forums.
  
  
What are we looking for
  
  

* Experience in technology risk management, information security, cyber risk, IT audit, operational resilience, regulatory compliance or a related field.
* Strong understanding of technology and cyber risk frameworks, controls, risk assessment methodologies and issue remediation processes.
* Experience supporting regulated financial services, payments, technology or operational resilience environments is preferred.
* Experience managing or participating in the RCSA process, ideally within a financial services, IT or payments context, including experience working in first- or second-line risk teams or within third-line Internal Audit functions in a financial services environment.
* Familiarity with regulatory requirements such as DORA,EBA ICT Guidelines, operational and security risk reporting, ICT risk management, third-party risk management and control effectiveness reporting.
* Ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outputs under regulatory or governance timelines.
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare concise reporting for senior management, committees, auditors and regulators.

**Qualifications**

* A bachelor's degree in technology, information security, computer science, risk management or a related discipline is preferred. Relevant professional experience will also be considered.
* Professional certifications such as CRISC, CISSP, CISM, CISA are desirable.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Oracle Fusion ITGC Analyst
description:
Support Oracle Fusion Financials and ITGC processes in a global enterprise environment
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Serve as the CIS division-wide subject matter expert for IT General Controls, SOX compliance, technology controls, and PCAOB audit readiness.
* Develop and maintain consistent ITGC policies, standards, control procedures, documentation, and evidence requirements across in-scope CIS applications and technologies.
* Partner with application owners, administrators, developers, infrastructure teams, Finance, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders to incorporate compliance by design into systems, integrations, changes, and operational processes.
* Configure and administer Fastpath GRC for User Access Reviews, segregation-of-duties monitoring, access-risk analysis, mitigating controls, audit-log reviews, and compliance reporting.
* Coordinate periodic access reviews and monitor privileged access, service accounts, segregation-of-duties conflicts, and joiner, mover, and leaver controls.
* Oversee controls for system development, change management, configuration changes, production migrations, computer operations, interfaces, batch processing, and audit logging.
* Conduct ITGC risk assessments, control walkthroughs, self-assessments, compliance reviews, and evaluations of control design and operating effectiveness.
* Identify control gaps, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate sustainable remediation of deficiencies and recurring exceptions.
* Act as the primary CIS liaison with internal and external auditors for ITGC walkthroughs, questionnaires, evidence requests, testing, findings, and remediation.
* Maintain an audit-ready documentation library, including control narratives, risk and control matrices, access reviews, change evidence, test results, SOC reports, bridge letters, and remediation records.
* Review third-party assurance reports and coordinate responses to exceptions, complementary user-entity controls, and other service-provider risks.
* Develop and deliver division-wide training, job aids, and guidance on SOX, ITGC, access governance, change controls, audit evidence, and control-owner responsibilities.
* Provide CIS leadership with reporting on audit readiness, control execution, deficiencies, remediation progress, and emerging compliance risks.
* Stay current on SOX Section 404, PCAOB, COSO, COBIT, ITGC, identity governance, cloud controls, and public-company compliance requirements.

**Requirement**

* Typically requires 4–6 years of experience in IT audit, IT risk and compliance, SOX, ITGC, application controls, financial systems, or a related technology-control function.
* Demonstrated experience designing, operating, assessing, or auditing ITGCs across enterprise applications and supporting technologies.
* Strong knowledge of access management, privileged access, segregation of duties, change management, system development, computer operations, interfaces, configuration management, and audit logging.
* Experience supporting SOX Section 404 compliance or audits of internal control over financial reporting.
* Experience conducting risk assessments, control walkthroughs, self-assessments, control testing, deficiency evaluations, and remediation validation.
* Experience coordinating with internal and external auditors and preparing complete, reliable, and timely audit evidence.
* Experience developing policies, procedures, control narratives, risk and control matrices, testing documentation, and audit workpapers.
* Familiarity with GRC, identity-governance, access-certification, audit-management, or compliance-monitoring applications.
* Understanding of SOC reports, bridge letters, complementary user-entity controls, and third-party assurance requirements.
* Strong analytical, project-management, communication, and stakeholder-influencing skills.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate compliance activities across global, cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field.

* You’re curious, passionate, authentic, and accountable. These are our values and influence everything we do.

**Role Overview**

* Proven expertise in security operations, including threat detection and hunting, incident response, vulnerability management, log analysis, event correlation, third-party risk management, and defining remediation strategies.
* Extensive knowledge of security governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks, including NIST, HIPAA, HITRUST, ITGC, and industry best practices, with experience supporting audits, risk assessments, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience developing and maintaining enterprise security policies, standards, procedures, technical baselines, and governance frameworks to strengthen organizational security posture.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity risk, business continuity, security controls, and emerging threat landscapes, with the ability to align security initiatives to business objectives.

title: Senior Identity Access Management Administrator
description:
**About Advanced Energy**
Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement and control solutions for mission-critical applications and processes. AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. Advanced Energy has devoted four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.
  
  
**Why be a part of advanced energy?**
Some people say it’s like working in the best of two worlds. We operate like an agile, growing, small company – you can see your work make a difference to the company every day. Things move quickly and you can see and feel it. At the same time, we’re a global company founded in 1981 and have been publicly traded for more than 28 years. We have a strong cash position, deep trust and partnership with leading customers, a global best-in-class operations capability, and a proven leadership team. We have a track record and resources to make things happen both organically and inorganically. Being part of a nimble company with a solid foundation attracts team members that are capable, driven and like a challenge. Our employees collaborate and know how to have fun inventing, working, building and winning together. At our core, we are Advanced Energy – powering the future, together.
  
  
**Position Summary:**
The Senior IT Security Administrator plays a critical role in shaping the future of identity security at Advanced Energy. This position offers the opportunity to lead enterprise-wide IAM initiatives, influence Zero Trust and AI Security strategy, and modernize identity controls across global cloud and SaaS environments. Working alongside security, infrastructure, and business leaders, you will drive solutions that protect the business while enabling growth and innovation. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a global technology organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* IAM Administration
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions supporting workforce, application, and AI/Non-human identities.
* Lead the integration, administration, and optimization of IAM platforms.
* Establish scalable identity solutions that support cloud-first and hybrid environments.
* Evaluate emerging IAM technologies and industry best practices to strengthen the organization's security posture.
* Identity Governance & Access Management
* Lead initiatives related to Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Access Management, AI Security, Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR), and Zero Trust security programs.
* Design and implement identity lifecycle management processes, including provisioning, deprovisioning, role management, and access certification activities.
* Develop and maintain authorization models including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), and Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC).
* Support segregation of duties (SoD), least privilege, just-in-time access, and privileged account governance programs.
* Authentication & Directory Services
* Administer and enhance enterprise Zero Trust controls, including Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), passwordless authentication, federation, conditional access controls, and network micro segmentation.
* Manage and support on-premise, cloud, and hybrid identity environments.
* Configure Identity Protection policies, Conditional Access policies, risk-based authentication controls, and adaptive access capabilities.
* Design and maintain integrations between identity platforms, cloud services, and business applications through APIs, provisioning connectors, and automation frameworks.
* Cloud & Application Integration
* Implement secure identity integrations with enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, and cloud environments including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Partner with application owners and development teams to ensure secure authentication and authorization controls are implemented consistently across platforms.
* Support application onboarding, federation, provisioning, and access governance activities.
* Automation & Operational Excellence
* Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, SQL, Power Automate, or similar technologies to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and support runbooks.
* Recommend and implement process improvements that enhance security, user experience, and operational effectiveness.
* Leadership & Collaboration
* Serve as a senior IAM subject matter expert and trusted advisor to Information Security, IT, Audit, Compliance, and business stakeholders.
* Lead technical projects from planning and design through deployment and operational transition.
* Mentor junior employees and provide technical guidance across IAM-related initiatives.
* Support audit, compliance, and regulatory activities by implementing appropriate controls and providing required evidence.
* Additional Duties
* Participate in identity-related incident response activities and root cause investigations.
* Stay informed of emerging IAM threats, technologies, and industry trends.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Working Conditions**

* Location: Pune, India
* Environment: Standard office environment utilizing standard office equipment; some travel may be necessary.
* Ability to work on projects with global team members outside of standard office hours.
* Weekend work and overtime may be required.
* Works in team and individual environments.
* Up to 25% travel (more may be necessary for projects); domestic and international.

**Qualifications:**
**Required Qualifications**

* Advanced knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM) principles, Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Zero Trust, AI Security, Identity Directory Services, Authentication and Authorization, and the Identity Lifecycle Management.
* Strong understanding of modern identity security concepts, including Zero Trust, least privilege, adaptive authentication, attribute and risk-based access controls, continuous access evaluation, and identity threat detection and response (ITDR).
* Advanced knowledge of on-premise, cloud, and hybrid identity environments.
* Knowledge of access control frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), and Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC).
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong organizational and project leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
* Ability to develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and operational runbooks.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of regulatory and compliance frameworks such as SOX, NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Familiarity with IT and Security platforms or applications within Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Zero Trust, AI Security and other enterprise driven product families.
* Understanding of cloud security architectures within Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform environments.

**Experience**
**Required Experience**

* Five (5) or more years of experience in Identity and Access Management, Cybersecurity Engineering, Information Security, or a related technical discipline.
* Three (3) or more years of experience administering and supporting enterprise IAM platforms and access management processes.
* Three (3) or more years of experience supporting on-premise, cloud, and/or hybrid identity directory services in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
* Experience implementing and supporting Enterprise Identity, Zero Trust, and AI Security solutions.
* Experience administering and maturing enterprise Zero Trust solutions, including Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), federation services, and conditional access policies.
* Experience integrating identity platforms with cloud providers, enterprise applications, and SaaS solutions.
* Experience designing and implementing user provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, role management, and access certification processes.
* Experience developing automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, SQL, Power Automate, or similar technologies.
* Experience leading technical projects from planning and design through implementation and operational support.
* Experience collaborating with Information Security, Infrastructure, Application Development, Audit, and business stakeholders to deliver IAM solutions.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with IAM platforms and technologies.
* Experience supporting global or manufacturing organizations.
* Experience supporting regulatory audits, compliance initiatives, and remediation activities.
* Experience implementing Zero Trust, Privileged Access Management, AI Security, or enterprise IAM modernization programs.

**Education:**
**Required**

**Preferred Certifications**

title: Junior Network Security Engineer
description:
A key objective of the position is to support the team in reducing the operational ticket backlog while maintaining service quality, security, and accurate documentation. The role performs initial analysis and troubleshooting, resolves standard and recurring requests based on documented procedures, and escalates complex issues to experienced engineers, the Network Security Architect, vendors, or service providers when required.
  
  
The position also supports platform monitoring, maintenance, lifecycle activities, audits, control reviews, documentation, and continuous service improvement. The Junior Network Security Engineer works under the guidance of experienced team members and gradually develops broader technical knowledge and operational responsibility across the Network Security & Trust service portfolio.
  
  
**We Offer**

* Incident, Service Request and Change Processing – 35%
* Process Network Security & Trust incidents, service requests, tasks, and standard changes using the designated IT service-management tool.
* Perform initial analysis, troubleshooting, classification, prioritization, and documentation of incoming tickets.
* Resolve standard and recurring issues by following approved procedures, knowledge articles, technical standards, and operational runbooks.
* Support the team in reducing the ticket backlog through structured processing, regular follow-up, and accurate status updates.
* Monitor assigned tickets and ensure timely processing in line with agreed priorities and service levels.
* Collect relevant technical information, logs, configurations, and error details before escalating complex cases.
* Escalate security-critical, high-impact, or technically complex issues to senior engineers, architects, vendors, or service providers.
* Support the planning, testing, documentation, and implementation of standard and low-risk changes.
* Participate in incident reviews, problem investigations, and root cause analysis under the guidance of experienced team members.
* Create and maintain knowledge articles, troubleshooting instructions, and operational runbooks for recurring issues.
* Firewall Operations and Security Policy Support – 25%
* Support the daily operation, monitoring, maintenance, and health checking of enterprise firewall services across on-premises, cloud, edge, and industrial environments.
* Implement approved firewall-rule, object, NAT, and security-policy changes by following established procedures and technical standards.
* Validate requests for completeness, approvals, ownership, source and destination information, ports, protocols, and business justification.
* Support the review, modification, deactivation, and removal of firewall rules and objects.
* Assist with firewall rule reviews, recertification, cleanup, and policy-optimization activities.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of firewall, NAT, security-policy, and communication-flow issues.
* Monitor firewall availability, capacity, performance, and operational alerts and escalate deviations where required.
* Support firewall platform maintenance, upgrades, backup and restore activities, and operational readiness checks.
* Maintain accurate firewall configuration records, operating procedures, diagrams, and technical documentation.
* VPN, Partner Connectivity and Segmentation Operations – 15%
* Support the implementation, maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting of site-to-site IPsec VPN connections.
* Process standard requests related to business partner, service provider, cloud, and third-party connectivity.
* Assist with the implementation and maintenance of approved network-segmentation controls, security zones, and controlled communication paths.
* Support NAC and microsegmentation activities from a network-security and policy-enforcement perspective.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of VPN availability, tunnel status, encryption parameters, network-security policies, and connectivity dependencies.
* Maintain accurate configuration, ownership, approval, and lifecycle information for VPN and partner-connectivity services.
* Support periodic reviews, recertification, deactivation, and removal of obsolete VPN connections and communication paths.
* Coordinate operational tasks with internal infrastructure teams, external partners, vendors, and managed service providers.
* PKI and Certificate Operations – 10%
* Process standard certificate requests and support the issuance, deployment, renewal, replacement, revocation, and retirement of digital certificates.
* Support operational activities related to Public Key Infrastructure and Certificate Lifecycle Management.
* Monitor certificate validity, upcoming expirations, service alerts, and certificate-related operational events.
* Assist application owners, infrastructure teams, network teams, and service providers with standard certificate requests and lifecycle activities.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of certificate enrollment, expiration, trust-chain, revocation, validation, and TLS-related issues.
* Maintain accurate certificate inventory, ownership, lifecycle, configuration, and operational information in the designated systems of record.
* Support the onboarding of applications, infrastructure platforms, network devices, users, and machine identities to approved certificate services.
* Support PKI and CLM platform maintenance, control reviews, audits, backup and restore activities, and operational documentation.
* Escalate complex issues related to PKI, Certificate Authorities, cryptography, trust models, or certificate integration to the responsible specialists.
* Service Reliability, Lifecycle and Compliance Support – 10%
* Perform recurring operational checks and maintenance activities for Network Security & Trust services.
* Support platform lifecycle activities, including software updates, upgrades, configuration reviews, backup verification, and operational readiness checks.
* Assist with monitoring service health, availability, capacity, certificate expiration, policy compliance, and operational risks.
* Support technical audits, control assessments, evidence preparation, recertification activities, and remediation of operational findings.
* Maintain the operational and technical documentation required for the assigned services and activities.
* Perform assigned activities in accordance with approved security standards, change procedures, separation-of-duties requirements, and operational controls.
* Contribute to service reporting by providing accurate ticket, incident, change, lifecycle, and operational information.
* Identify recurring issues, missing documentation, and operational risks and communicate them to the responsible senior team members.
* Continuous Improvement and Automation Support – 5%
* Contribute to the standardization and simplification of recurring operational activities.
* Identify repetitive tasks that may be suitable for templates, scripts, workflows, APIs, or other forms of automation.
* Support the testing and use of approved automation for configuration validation, reporting, certificate lifecycle processing, and operational checks.
* Assist senior engineers and architects with technical testing, implementation activities, and operational handover.
* Contribute to the improvement of knowledge articles, troubleshooting procedures, request forms, and operational runbooks.
* Participate in team knowledge-sharing, technical training, service reviews, and continuous-improvement activities.

**Interfaces**
Internal:
  
  

* Network Security & Trust team and Network Security Architect
* Related infrastructure, network, cloud, workplace, application, and Cyber Security teams
* IT service-management and support functions
* Regional IT teams, system and application owners, and project teams
* Architecture, risk, compliance, and audit functions

**External**

* Firewall, VPN, NAC, PKI, CLM, and security-technology vendors
* Certificate service providers and external trust-service partners
* Security integrators and implementation partners
* Cloud service providers and external business partners

**Tasks And Qualifications**
**Experience:**

* Initial professional experience, internship experience, working-student experience, or practical training in IT infrastructure, network operations, network security, cyber security, PKI, certificate management, or a comparable technical environment
* Basic practical experience with firewalls, VPNs, network-security controls, certificates, or IT operations is an advantage
* Experience processing technical tickets or working with an IT service-management tool is an advantage
* Initial experience with incident handling, technical troubleshooting, documentation, or standard changes is an advantage
* Exposure to enterprise firewall, VPN, PKI, certificate management, CLM, or comparable infrastructure-security technologies is an advantage
* Experience in an international or distributed IT environment is an advantage but not mandatory
* Strong willingness to learn Network Security & Trust technologies and gradually assume broader operational responsibility

**Qualifications/Specialization**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Telecommunications, Electronics, or a comparable technical discipline
* A comparable technical vocational qualification combined with relevant practical experience may also be considered
* Entry-level certifications or training such as Fortinet Certified Fundamentals, Fortinet Certified Associate, Cisco CCNA, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft security fundamentals, ITIL Foundation, or comparable qualifications are an advantage
* Initial PKI, certificate-management, cryptography, or CLM product training is an advantage but not mandatory

**Soft Skills**

* Strong service orientation and willingness to support the team in reducing the operational ticket backlog
* Reliable, structured, and accurate working style
* Strong willingness to learn and develop technical knowledge
* Ownership of assigned tickets and operational tasks
* Ability to follow procedures while identifying unclear or missing information
* Good analytical thinking and basic troubleshooting skills
* Ability to recognize when escalation or additional support is required

* Good written and spoken English

And through it all, we continually laid a solid, forward-looking foundation on which future generations can continue growing and achieving greater.
  
  
Northern Trust is looking for an Associate to join its Technology Development Center in Pune, India.
  
  
**Job Description AND Principal Responsibilities**
The Vulnerability Management Associate is a technical support role within the Vulnerability Management function, providing day-to-day platform administration, technical analysis, data validation, integration monitoring, testing, reporting, and support for enterprise Vulnerability Management technologies.
  
  
This role works closely with VM Engineers to provide day-to-day technical support across the Vulnerability Management technology ecosystem, with a focus on platform monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, integration support, testing, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The role will support technologies including Qualys, Zafran Security, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow integrations, Policy Compliance, and Attack Surface Management capabilities.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities/Requirements**

* Provide day-to-day technical and platform support for Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, and associated integrations.
* Monitor platform health, scanning activity, integrations, data feeds, API jobs, asset coverage, and data completeness.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of scanner, agent, authentication, API, integration, and data-ingestion issues and escalate complex engineering issues to VM Engineers.
* Support Qualys scanner and agent operations, including scan status, authentication results, failed scans, coverage, and troubleshooting.
* Support Qualys Policy Compliance activities, including policy/profile maintenance, control mapping, authentication issues, configuration assessments, and reporting.
* Support Wiz cloud-security and configuration-compliance capabilities, including validation of findings, coverage, data feeds, and integrations.
* Support Aqua and Kubernetes/container security platforms, including monitoring scanning coverage, image/registry/cluster data, integrations, and platform issues.
* Monitor Zafran data ingestion and enrichment from connected security technologies and identify missing, stale, or inconsistent data.
* Validate that vulnerability, asset, threat, exposure, and compensating-control information is flowing correctly into Zafran.
* Support and test Zafran AI agent use cases and automation opportunities identified by VM Engineering.
* Assist VM Engineers with testing and validation of Python/API automation and ServiceNow workflow changes.
* Monitor ServiceNow integrations to ensure vulnerability records, assignments, enrichment, status updates, and closure information are flowing correctly between systems.
* Investigate integration failures, incorrect assignments, missing enrichment, duplicate records, asset-matching issues, and other data-quality problems.
* Support Attack Surface Management by validating discovered assets, investigating ownership and attribution data, and ensuring ASM information flows appropriately into downstream VM platforms.
* Perform UAT/testing and validation for platform upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, new automation, and new security capabilities.
* Assist VM Engineers with POCs, implementations, platform migrations, and integration testing.
* Produce platform-support reporting covering scanner health, coverage, integration status, failed jobs, data quality, enrichment, and other engineering metrics.
* Maintain platform inventories, configurations, support documentation, knowledge articles, procedures, and runbooks.
* Work closely with VM Engineering to identify recurring support issues that should be permanently resolved through engineering or automation.
* Work with VM Operations when platform or data issues affect their remediation processes, while leaving vulnerability remediation ownership with the existing VM Operations team.

Skill / Experience
  
  
**Minimum**

* Experience supporting Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, Security Platforms, or Cybersecurity Operations technologies.
* Working knowledge of Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow, ASM, or comparable technologies.
* Understanding of vulnerability scanning, authenticated scanning, agents, asset inventory, and Policy Compliance/configuration assessment.
* Familiarity with cloud, Kubernetes, containers, Linux, Windows, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and automation concepts; Python experience is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot data feeds, integrations, authentication, scanning, coverage, and platform issues.
* Understanding of ServiceNow/CMDB integrations and vulnerability workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate large datasets and identify coverage, enrichment, integration, and data-quality issues.
* Ability to work closely with engineers and learn complex enterprise security technologies.
* Experience supporting security technologies within a large enterprise environment preferred.

**Preferred**

* 5-8 years of relevant experience
* Any infosec certifications or related (desired, not a compulsion)

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Exposure Management Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a cybersecurity professional with strong experience in vulnerability management, risk assessment, infrastructure security, security operations, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate should be comfortable communicating with both technical teams and executive leadership while driving measurable reductions in organizational cyber risk.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Vulnerability & Attack Surface Management**
Govern the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle including identification, assessment, prioritization, remediation tracking, validation, and closure.
  
  
Perform vulnerability analysis using industry-standard tools.
  
  
Conduct risk-based prioritization using CVSS scores, exploitability data, business impact, threat intelligence, and asset criticality.
  
  
Track remediation activities and ensure adherence to established remediation SLAs.
  
  
Stay informed on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices.
  
  
**Automation**
Develop and maintain automated security workflows to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual efforts.
  
  
Utilize SOAR platforms, existing tool capabilities, and integrations to streamline security operations.
  
  
**Risk & Exposure Management**
Evaluate newly disclosed vulnerabilities, zero-day threats, and critical security advisories.
  
  
Assess business risk associated with vulnerabilities and provide remediation recommendations.
  
  
Drive reduction of organizational attack surface and cyber exposure.

title: Security Analyst
description:
Job Description: Security Analyst – Endpoint Security, SIEM & Vulnerability Management

Location: Pune/Noida/Bangalore, India

Experience 2–5 years

Department IT Infrastructure & Information Security

Employment Full-time

About Onextel

Onextel Limited delivers enterprise communication technology and CPaaS solutions including SMS, WhatsApp Business API, Voice, RCS, Email and telecom messaging infrastructure to enterprises, financial institutions and government organizations.

Role Overview

We seek a hands-on Security Analyst to monitor and strengthen cybersecurity across enterprise endpoints, Windows/Linux servers, virtualized infrastructure and networks. The role covers SIEM monitoring, EDR/XDR investigation, vulnerability tracking, incident response and remediation coordination, working closely with Infrastructure, Network and Development teams.

Key Responsibilities

Security Monitoring & SIEM Operations

* Monitor events using Microsoft Sentinel, Wazuh, ELK Stack, Splunk or equivalent SIEM platforms.
* Analyze and correlate Windows, Linux, endpoint, firewall and network logs; investigate suspicious activity and unauthorized access.
* Develop and tune detection queries and rules (including KQL), reduce false positives and maintain dashboards.

Endpoint Detection & Response

* Monitor, configure and administer EDR/XDR and antivirus solutions such as Microsoft Defender XDR or CrowdStrike.
* Investigate malware, phishing, suspicious processes, ransomware indicators and endpoint compromises.
* Monitor agent health, coverage and updates; troubleshoot agents and coordinate isolation, containment and recovery.

Vulnerability & Patch Management

* Identify and track CVEs, missing patches, insecure configurations and vulnerabilities using Qualys, Nessus, OpenVAS or equivalent tools.
* Prioritize findings by CVSS, exploitability and asset criticality; coordinate remediation and validate closure.
* Maintain vulnerability registers, patch compliance dashboards and remediation reports.

Security Incident Response & Investigation

* Triage and investigate brute-force attempts, unauthorized access, malware and suspicious authentication events.
* Analyze email headers, IPs, domains and IOCs using VirusTotal, AlienVault OTX, MISP and other intelligence sources.
* Apply MITRE ATT&CK and Cyber Kill Chain concepts; document incident classification, escalation, RCA and closure.

Linux, Windows & Infrastructure Security

* Analyze operating-system authentication logs, processes, access controls, ports and network connections.
* Support Linux/Windows hardening, CIS baseline reviews, server security and virtualized infrastructure security.
* Coordinate remediation of insecure services, outdated packages and unauthorized changes.

Network & Firewall Security

* Review firewall, VPN, IDS/IPS and network logs for scanning, malicious traffic and unauthorized connections.
* Use TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SSH and HTTP/HTTPS fundamentals to investigate incidents.
* Coordinate firewall rule reviews, malicious-IP blocking and network containment with administrators.

Threat Intelligence & Automation

* Perform IOC enrichment, basic threat hunting and threat-intelligence monitoring.
* Use Python, PowerShell or Bash to automate log analysis, checks, alert triage and reporting.

Reporting, Compliance & Governance

* Prepare daily monitoring summaries and weekly/monthly security posture reports.
* Maintain incident records, vulnerability trackers, SOPs and escalation workflows.
* Support ISO 27001 controls, audit evidence, security policy compliance and corrective-action tracking.

Required Technical Skills

* SIEM: Microsoft Sentinel, Wazuh, ELK Stack, Splunk or equivalent; KQL, log correlation
* Endpoint: Microsoft Defender XDR, CrowdStrike or equivalent EDR/XDR; endpoint security
* Operating systems: Windows, Windows Server, Linux/Ubuntu; security log and process analysis
* Incident response: Alert triage, phishing/malware investigation, escalation, containment and RCA
* Vulnerabilities: CVE/CVSS, vulnerability scanning, patch management and remediation tracking
* Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SSH, VPN and firewall fundamentals
* Threat intelligence: MITRE ATT&CK, IOCs, VirusTotal, MISP or equivalent
* Automation: Python, PowerShell or Bash

Good-to-Have Skills

* DLP and MDM/UEM
* Netskope CASB/SWG
* Fortinet firewalls
* Proxmox virtualization
* CIS hardening
* IDS/IPS
* Zero Trust
* SOAR
* ISO 27001

Qualifications & Certifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, Cybersecurity or a related discipline
* Minimum 2 years of relevant cybersecurity or infrastructure security experience.
* Preferred (not mandatory): Microsoft SC-200, CompTIA Security+/CySA+, Splunk, Qualys, Cisco cybersecurity or CEH certifications.

Key Performance Indicators

* Endpoint and server security monitoring coverage and agent health.
* Timely identification, investigation and escalation of security alerts.
* Accuracy and completeness of incident investigations and documentation.
* Vulnerability and patch remediation tracking against agreed SLAs.
* Quality of security reports, detection tuning and operational improvements.

Candidate Profile

A proactive analyst with practical SIEM, EDR, Windows/Linux log analysis, vulnerability management and investigation experience. Willingness to build further hands-on capability in enterprise DLP, MDM and security platform administration is desirable.

description:

With our
**Leading Payment Orchestration Platform**
, we’re turning payments into a strategic advantage, helping clients optimize their payment experience to boost profits, maximize approvals, lower costs and take control of their payment, resulting in more money to the bottom line.

**strategic asset**

**profit engine**

At our core,
**we're innovators**
and
**problem-solvers**
united by five key values: Mission First, Ownership, Trust & Transparency, Driven, and One Team. We're ambitious professionals who embrace accountability and transform payments together.

Our diverse community spans the globe, with hubs in Copenhagen, Dallas, Dubai, London, Miami, Pune, Buenos Aires, Bogota, Mexico, and Singapore, along with remote team members worldwide. We celebrate the unique perspectives and experiences that make our team extraordinary.

Join us as a
**Security Engineer**
on our mission to turn payments into possibilities!

Location: India Industry: Fintech / Payment Orchestration

**Security Engineer**

Join CellPoint Digital as a Security Engineer. You are the builder and the mechanic of our security ecosystem. Your mission is to turn architectural designs into high-performing, automated reality. In our 1-2-2 team model, you provide the technical "muscle" that allows our Architects to maintain compliance and our Lead to drive strategy.

You will be on the front lines of several critical greenfield projects: implementing our Just-In-Time (JIT) access platform, technically configuring our SIEM/SOAR within Google Cloud, and—crucially—automating our compliance evidence collection via the Sprinto GRC platform to eliminate manual toil. You are someone who believes that if a task has to be done twice, it should be scripted.

**How You Will Make an Impact:**

* Automation & GRC Engineering: Support the Senior Architects by building and maintaining API integrations between our tech stack and Sprinto. Your goal is to eliminate manual evidence collection by writing automation (Python/Go) that feeds real-time configuration data from GCP, GitHub, and CrowdStrike into the GRC platform.
* SIEM/SOAR Implementation (GCP SCC): Perform the technical setup and tuning of GCP Security Command Center. Build and maintain the automated "Playbooks" that allow our systems to self-remediate common security events (e.g., auto-isolating a compromised GKE pod).
* Zero-Trust & Identity Operations: Execute the technical rollout of Ploy (JIT). Manage the day-to-day health and tuning of our Twingate (ZTNA) connectors and JumpCloud policies to ensure seamless, secure access for a global team.
* Shift-Left & CI/CD Tuning: Maintain security scanners (SAST/DAST) within GitHub Actions. Work directly with developers to tune SonarCloud rules, reducing false positives and ensuring that the "Shift-Left" process is high-fidelity and low-friction.
* Operational Defense & MDR Support: Act as the primary technical responder for escalations from our CrowdStrike MDR service. Perform hands-on remediation, containment, and forensic investigation within the GCP environment.
* Resilience & DRP Execution: Build and maintain the automation scripts used for Disaster Recovery (DRP) failover. Lead regular "Game Day" exercises to ensure that our recovery procedures are functional, documented, and meet RTO/RPO targets.
* Automation Rate: Percentage of GRC evidence collected automatically via Sprinto APIs vs. manual uploads (Target: >80% of technical controls).
* Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR): Tracking the speed of resolving critical vulnerabilities identified by SonarCloud or GCP SCC.
* Tool Coverage: Ensuring 100% deployment of CrowdStrike and Twingate across all relevant endpoints and cloud workloads.
* DRP Readiness: Successful execution of technical recovery playbooks during scheduled Disaster Recovery tests.

**Skills you will have fine-tuned:**

* Experience: 4+ years of hands-on Security Engineering experience in a cloud-native (GCP preferred) environment.
* The Automation Mindset: Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, or Go) and experience working with REST APIs to connect disparate security tools.
* GCP Hands-on: Practical experience with GCP IAM, Networking, Log Router, and GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine).
* Endpoint & Perimeter Expert: Proficiency in tuning EDR policies (CrowdStrike) and managing modern access tools (Twingate/JumpCloud).
* AppSec Foundational Knowledge: A solid understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and experience integrating security tools into GitHub Actions pipelines.
* Attention to detail, plus analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Positive, service-oriented personality
* Willingness to travel to our global locations
* You are eager to bring your unique talents and authenticity to the CellPoint Digital community.
* You're constantly curious and a lifetime learner.
* You have excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
* You enjoy leading and supporting cross-functional initiatives and projects in a team where you are empowered and accountable.
* You thrive in a fast-paced environment and the challenge of managing multiple projects simultaneously while prioritizing high-return work.
* You approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset.

title: Sr. System Administrator
description:
Senior Server Administrator – IT Infrastructure
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Senior Server Administrator is responsible for the design, administration, maintenance, security, and continuous improvement of the organisation’s server and IT infrastructure environment. The role will ensure that infrastructure services remain secure, resilient, highly available, and aligned with business requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide senior-level technical expertise across physical and virtual server environments, operating systems, storage, backup, monitoring, patching, and infrastructure security. They will also play a key role in incident resolution, infrastructure projects, service improvements, and technical planning.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Server & Infrastructure Administration
  
  

* Administer and maintain Windows and/or Linux server environments across physical and virtual platforms.
* Manage server hardware, operating systems, virtualisation platforms, storage, and associated infrastructure services.
* Monitor system performance, capacity, availability, and health, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
* Perform server builds, configuration, upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning in accordance with established standards.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, configuration records, and technical procedures.
* Ensure infrastructure platforms are appropriately configured for availability, performance, and resilience.

Infrastructure Operations & Support
  
  

* Provide senior-level technical support for infrastructure incidents, service requests, and problems.
* Troubleshoot complex server, operating system, networking, storage, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Participate in an on-call or out-of-hours support rota where required.
* Lead or support the resolution of major incidents and provide root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Work closely with service desk, network, security, application, and other IT teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Maintain server security in line with organisational policies and industry best practices.
* Manage operating system patching, vulnerability remediation, antivirus/endpoint protection, and security configuration.
* Support security audits, compliance requirements, and infrastructure risk assessments.
* Implement and maintain appropriate access controls, privileged access, and server hardening standards.
* Work with cybersecurity teams to investigate and remediate infrastructure security incidents.

Backup, Recovery & Business Continuity
  
  

* Manage and monitor server backup and recovery solutions.
* Regularly test backup restoration and disaster recovery procedures.
* Support the development and maintenance of infrastructure disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Ensure critical infrastructure services meet agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives.

Projects & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Lead or contribute to infrastructure projects, including server upgrades, migrations, cloud adoption, virtualisation, and technology refresh programmes.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure services.
* Identify opportunities to automate routine administration and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain technical standards, processes, and best-practice procedures.
* Support capacity planning and future infrastructure strategy.

Stakeholder & Supplier Management
  
  

* Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, and third-party suppliers.
* Provide technical guidance and communicate complex infrastructure issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support supplier management, technical reviews, and service improvement activities where required.
* Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior infrastructure team members.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in a senior server/infrastructure administration role.
* Strong experience administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments.
* Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and core infrastructure services.
* Experience with virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Strong understanding of server hardware, storage, networking, and infrastructure architecture.
* Experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Strong knowledge of server security, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and hardening.
* Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure incidents and performing root-cause analysis.
* Good understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management processes.
* Experience working with monitoring and infrastructure management tools.
* Strong documentation and technical communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical issues.

Desirable Skills
  
  

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure platforms.
* Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting/automation technologies.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience with enterprise storage technologies.
* Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery architectures.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Linux, ITIL, or cloud certifications.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Technical expertise: Demonstrates strong knowledge of server and infrastructure technologies.
* Problem solving: Able to diagnose complex technical problems and develop effective solutions.
* Ownership: Takes responsibility for infrastructure services and follows issues through to resolution.
* Communication: Communicates clearly with technical teams, management, suppliers, and business stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement: Identifies opportunities to improve reliability, security, performance, and efficiency.
* Teamwork: Works effectively across IT teams and supports knowledge sharing.
* Resilience: Able to manage priorities and remain effective during incidents and high-pressure situations.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  

* Infrastructure availability and reliability.
* Timely resolution of infrastructure incidents and problems.
* Successful completion of infrastructure projects and upgrades.
* Server patching and vulnerability remediation compliance.
* Backup success rates and successful recovery testing.
* Infrastructure security and compliance performance.
* Reduction in recurring incidents and infrastructure-related risks.
* Quality and accuracy of infrastructure documentation.
* Delivery of automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Role Summary
  
  
The Senior Server Administrator will be a key member of the IT Infrastructure team, responsible for ensuring the stability, security, resilience, and performance of critical server and infrastructure services. The role requires a proactive and technically capable individual who can manage day-to-day operations while also contributing to strategic infrastructure improvements and business continuity.

* Direct exposure to enterprise-scale cloud security migrations.
* Competitive compensation and clear technical career progression.

title: WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager
